museum: National Museum of Antiquities (Rijksmuseum van Oudheden)
possible_additional_holdings: The reference chains in the Europeana records run Leemans 1840 N 28, 29, 31, 32, 33; Boeser 1907 E.XLV.24, 26, 27, 28, 29; Raven/Taconis 2005 cat. 113, 114, 116, 117, 118, 119. The gaps (Leemans N 30 / Boeser E.XLV.25 / Raven-Taconis cat. 115) may correspond to one further crocodile mummy not published on Europeana (possibly AMM 16h, which is not in Europeana) - unverified; RMO own DB blocked by Cloudflare.
scholarly_catalogue: M.J. Raven & W.K. Taconis, Egyptian Mummies. Radiological Atlas of the Collections in the National Museum of Antiquities at Leiden (Turnhout 2005), cat. 113-119; Leemans, Description raisonnée (1840); Boeser, Catalogus (1907)
